newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bovespa resumes trade in Belgo Mineira.
newsitem.headline: Bovespa resumes trade in Belgo Mineira.

text.p: The Sao Paulo bourse said it resumed trade in Brazilian steelmaker Belgo Mineira this afternoon after the company clarified a local wire report on the firm's possible losses caused by recent heavy rains.

Trade had been suspended earlier because a local wire service said Belgo Mineira, which is located in Minas Gerais state, was likely to show losses of up to 120 million reais after flood waters damaged one of its plants, the bolsa said.
The report also said the unit would have to halt production for 20 days, according to the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa).

Belgo Mineira said the plant belongs to its subsidiary BMB Belgo Mineira Bekaert Artefatos de Arame Ltda, adding that a preliminary upraisal of damages showed that the unit could resume production in 15 days. It also said it should not spend more than 8.0 million reais to restore the unit.
